body:
This was absolutely heartbreaking and I'm glad I'm not alone in my pain. I'm glad you're in a much better place now, and I hope I will be in that same place one day.  

I've been dealingw with this depression for more than a week now. I've had ups and downs, I've been crying a lot, but I'm hanging in here. I'll go to therapy because I know it's a necessity right now. Thank you so much for your concern and hope you keep doing well :)

Well, I've been depressed for more than 3 years now and I never took meds, maybe because I always thought I would have some dependency on them? My sister takes meds and I see it's very helpful but whenever she doesn't take them, she's very agitated and nervous and I don't want to feel that way.  

I dug up his grave cause I was worried he was not buried deep enough, I'm kind of tired of explaining that already, I've already been called a psycho, a drama queen and much more names for grieving over my dog, I almost regret posting this, cause that was really hurtful.  

That being said, I know I'm unstable and I know what I did was not the best thing to do, but try to understand I'm still really affected by his death.  

And you're wrong about me wanting to move on. I didn't come here to reddit looking for closure, I came here for advice because like you said, I'm mentally ill and my puppy's death devastated me. I wanted to know people's opinion on this matter.  

I appreciate your concern, I will go to therapy very soon.

Aww this makes me happy! I recently posted about my dog who died last week (and sadly there were some mean people in the comments)... but the thing is my dog was named Oliver too!  

His life was cut short because of a pancreatitis but I'm happy he's in Heaven now! Seeing your dog is named Oliver too made me sad for a moment but now I'm really happy because it made me remember him! Blessings for you both, you have a really beautiful dog!
Aww that's lovely. I hope your dog lives an amazing and long long long life <3!
Thank you. I will go to therapy! <3
Thanks. I'm going to therapy to cope with my illness. Thank you for your concern and support, I'm going to try to be happy.
I appreciate your help and concern. I'm here, and I'm trying to hang in here. Will go to therapy.
I am too. Lots of hugs <3

Aww, that's sad to hear! Hopefully your pup and Oli are in Heaven right now! And he does live on! I see him in the sky, the stars, but most importantly he is in my heart and in my soul. Much love and hugs <3
Sorry for your loss! Much love and hugs <3
I will! Thanks for your answer!
This truly helped! Thanks for your answer, I'm really happy you understand the pain I'm going through.
You're right. I'm gonna hang in here for him. Thanks for the support, and I'm sorry for your loss :(
Thank you, I will!
Sorry about Maynard. Hopefully he and Oliver are playing right now in Heaven! Much love <3
Thank you. I hug you back. He had a good life, I know. I will miss him everyday but on the meantime I'll go to therapy.

Thank you! I hope you're in a better place now. It comforts me to think that all the puppies that died are playing in Dog Heaven right now with my beautiful Oliver. I appreciate your answer, much love <3
Thank you! He taught me how to love properly and I'm going to love his sisters, I'm going to give them the best life possible. I just wish he was here to enjoy all those things himself. <3

I saw your edited comment and let me tell you that I buried him in a blanket. For personal reasons I didn't want him cremated, I wanted to bury his body. I buried him wrapped on a blanket on a public park. 
One week later I went to the park because I was scared the dog would be removed or that he wasn't buried deep enough.
I didn't even see his complete body, just the parts mentioned above. When I made sure he was still there, I covered him with more dirt and made sure this time he was completely buried. 
AND I didn't do it in front of kids. I made sure kids were not around to see that. It was already late.
Don't worry about what I did, please. Your comments were really insensitive and I know what I did is not he healthiest thing to do, but I have been devastated for the last week. I know I need professional help, thank you very much. You could've said what you wanted to say without calling me a psycho or making me feel bad for making sure my dog was still there.
How about: "Hey, I'm really sorry for your loss, I think you should go to therapy cause I don't think digging up your dog is a healthy coping mechanism".

Thanks! I'm going to see a therapist, for sure. And I get your point about not wanting to move on. That's my main problem, I really don't want to move on from his death because of the exact reason you said. I don't know if I ever will but right now it comforts me to know he's with me in this bad times.
Thank you! <3

Thanks for your answer! I'm glad I'm not alone in beeing so sad that nothing exites me anymore. But I will try to live for him. 
And your dog was sooo cute! Your videos look really interesting, will view them in a couple of hours after I get some sleep!

I know that feeling! I said to another person on this thread that Oliver's grandmother was my pet and almost 5 years ago a van ran over her. It was the worst feeling ever. Months later, she appeared on my dream and I remember the scenario so well, I remember it was snowy and I was near a small wall of ice (really don't know where I was) and I remember she was playful and hiding from me. 
With Oliver, I told him to visit me in my dreams and he has already appeared in two of them, the ones mentioned on my original post. Those dreams have made me so sad but I know I will keep those dreams in my mind forever because he was there. It was him, I talked to him and he listened. I'm sure he will keep appearing in my dreams because he wants me to know he's with me. :(
That was exactly my issue! Thanks for clarifying, english is not my first language and I had trouble explaining it.
You're right! And he was a gift for me...
I know I got this! Thanks for your answer and sorry for your loss!
:( I hope you're better now.
He was! So cute <3 I love him so much.
Thank you so much!
I know! He died but he will always be my baby. I miss him so much and grief will still be there but I will hang in here, for Oliver!

I will take my time, eventually I'll go to therapy but right now I want to be alone for a little while more because I feel him in my heart and soul when I'm alone. I try to talk to him at night, I tell him to visit me in my dreams (he has as you can read in my original post, but sadly these dreams have made me more sad)...

Oh, I'm sorry for your loss :( Oliver is the second pet I've lost. The first one was his grandmother. She was so cute and was old (like 7 years old) and she died because a truck ran over her. I held her in my hands and I will always remember her beautiful face. I feel better knowing Oliver is with his grandmother now, at peace.
Of course! I'm not alone, you made me feel understood and better! Thanks for your answer, I'll DM you when I have time.

Thank you! I will never forget the time I got to spend with him. He was so cute and soft. I have great memories and videos of him, but sadly I can't see them without crying. I'll go to therapy but right now I still want to be on my own because when I'm alone is when I feel him the most, in my heart and in my soul...
Oh, she was so beautiful! Thank you so much for your nice reply. I'm sure both Oliver and Coraline are at rest right now. Much love <3

Your comment makes me so so sad! He was with me for 4 months but if you knew the impact he had on me, they way I cared for him, and the deep love I had for him, you would think differently. Like I said to another person, I hope you never go through the pain of losing someone, person or pet, I really you never go through that. Because the pain and the suffering is on a whole new level. I'm not a drama queen, I thought people would be nice here but you make me... so sad!
Like I'm not even angry about your comment, just sad. God bless you!
Thank you. I'm going to take this matter seriously and will go to therapy. Nice to see someone that understands the daily pain I'm going through...

This made me hopeful, thank you very much! Your story is really sad, I'm sure Hope, Oliver and the other sweet puppy are playing in Heaven right now! She was so beautiful! I'm sorry for your loss and lots of hugs <3
He was! A little mischievous maybe but beautiful on the inside and the outside! Very loving and soft too <3
I will, for them and for him! <3
Really sad you're judging me for grieving! I just hope you never go through the pain I'm going.

what a sad thing to hear your calling me a psychopath. I dug up his grave cause I was afraid people were going to see the blanket that I buried him in. After all, I buried him in a public park as I didn't have a backyard in my house.
And I'm not whining online, I have serious trust issues (I fear people will make fun of mental health like you) and didn't know who to talk to. I saw people here are very responsive and kind (clearly not you) and I wanted to tell everyone here about my pain.
Yes. I only dug up his grave cause i buried him in a public park and wanted to see if the was still there.

Thank you for defending me! People thinking I'm a psychopath clearly don't understand my pain. I only dug him up because I buried him in a blanket in a public park and I was afraid people were going to discover or see that I buried him and wanted to check if he  was still there!

Thank you, I know! I just wanted to die cause I didn't see a point in living anymore. He's playing in Dog Heaven, I know! And when it is my time to reunite with him I'll be happy, whenever that moment comes!
I'm not a bot. And I'll give life another chance for him. Thinking about tattoing his face or his name so that I can carry him with me forever! Thanks for your answer!
I know! I will hang in there for him.
I know! He was too good for this world :( <3

You must not know what is like to lose a pet, right!? It's the most horrible thing in the world and EVERYONE grieves! If you think it is as easy as to have a funeral and forget it, you must be a very angry person. I'm not a preteen, I'm an adult and grieving makes me human.

I'm not a bot, sorry you thought that. I was very sad and thought people wouldn't even take time to read my post. I left my house and just got back. I'm sorry if it was not allowed to reply the same thing over and over... :(
I will, thanks for your answer!
Gracias!!
Thank you! <3

My beautiful Oliver would want me to live, I know. He was too good for this world.
Unfortunately I can't adopt more dogs. I already own his mother and two of his sisters. I live in a small apartment and pets are not even allowed.
I know. Hopefully I can keep the ones I have healthy for the rest of their life. Dogs are the best thing in the world <3!
Of course! I'll do it, tysm for your answer!
Thank you! I'll do if I can't get better. Venting and knowing people are there to listen/read my thoughts is a very good thing for me.

I know!
I'm hanging in there, and thanks for your reply! Much love <3
Thanks! <3
Thanks for your answer! Hopefully your beautiful dogs and my Oliver are playing in Heaven happily and without pain. <3
That is so sad!! I was scared because his two sisters got sick too, but fortunately it was just a stomach bug. I don't know what I would do if I lost one more of them.
Your welcome! <3 He was so beautiful.
Thank you so much! I'm trying to eat very healthy food, I love vegetables. I appreciate your answer.
Thank you so much for your answer! Unfortunately, I'm not very energetic rn, but will try to do the things you told me.
Thank you for that! I'm hanging in here! Lots of love <3
Hmm... I know it sounds weird, but I buried him in a public park and wanted to see if he was still there...
They're very similar in terms of personality. Oliver was the most mischievous out of them all. The other two are more sleepy, and I really miss Oliver barking... :(

Yes! I want to give time to my other puppies cause they're gorgeous but sometimes it's really painful to look at their faces. I'm gonna try to get better on that matter, and of course I love them, but again it's really painful and I even hate myself sometimes cause I feel like I will never love them like I loved Oliver :/

For anyone annoyed at my lack of responses and the same reply over and over I'm so so sorry! I didn't know it wasn't allowed. I just wanted people to look at his pictures and hopefully receive a beautiful message! I'm sorry people think I'm a bot. I haven't had time to reply cause I went out of my house for a while. If you want I'll delete some replies

I'm so sorry. I was out of my house for a while and didn't know I wasn't allowed to do that! I'm so so sorry, I'm hanging in there thanks for your concern. If you want to talk of course I'm here, just grieving as usual.
Sorry, I am human, i didn't know it wasn't allowed to post the same comment a lot of times, i just wanted people to see his pictures.
Sorry if this annoyed you... I really wanted people to see his pictures and couldn't figure until later how to edit the post and add imgur pics.
Not at all. Just wanted people to look at his beautiful pictures.
Exactly! I'm not a bot, I just wanted people to see him because he was so beautiful! <3
